The fellowship is Rs. 58,000.00 per month plus HRA as per IIT (ISM) Dhanbad rules. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: PhD in Computational and theoretical Chemistry/Biology or a closely related field. Experience in MD simulations and free-energy calculations of biomolecules with AI/ML modelling is mandatory, with proven publications in high-impact-factor journals. Experience in Molecular Dynamics and enhanced sampling simulation, machine learning, data analytics. The age limit and any relaxation are as per the norms of the Govt. of India. The notice does not print a specific number of years or an "as on" date for counting age. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the Research Associate-I post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Research Associate-I receives a fellowship of Rs. 58,000.00 PM. HRA is paid on top of this, as per the rules of IIT (ISM) Dhanbad. The notice does not name any other allowance.

content_sections.heading: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Research Associate-I Job Description
content_sections.text: According to the notice, the selected candidate is expected to: Conduct all-atom Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations. Carry out alchemical free energy calculations (SAFEP). Perform non-equilibrium egress profiling. Perform network analysis. Pair this work with conditional AI/ML surrogate modelling of efflux pumps.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Research Associate-I
content_sections.text: Applications are sent by email to the Principal Investigator. There is no online form or postal application in the notice. Combine your documents into a single PDF file: (i) CV, (ii) related publications, and (iii) proof of work experience (if any). Write "Application for the position of PDF under Gates Foundation project" in the subject of the email. Email the single PDF to the PI at [email protected] . Send the email by 30 November 2026. The notice does not print a closing time. CV Related publications Proof of work experience (if any)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on their merit and as per the requirements of the project. Mere possession of the minimum qualification does not guarantee an invitation to the interview. Shortlisted candidates will be informed of the date of the interview; the notice does not give the interview date or mode. All candidates should make their own arrangements for their stay at Dhanbad, if required. No TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Research Associate-I recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 Research Associate-I position in the Gates Foundation project at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Research Associate-I post?
faq.answer: The application must be emailed to [email protected] by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Research Associate-I post?
faq.answer: A PhD in Computational and theoretical Chemistry/Biology or a closely related field is required. Experience in MD simulations and free-energy calculations of biomolecules with AI/ML modelling, with proven publications in high-impact-factor journals, is mandatory.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Research Associate-I post?
faq.answer: The age limit and relaxation are as per the norms of the Govt. of India.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Research Associate-I?
faq.answer: The fellowship is Rs. 58,000.00 PM plus HRA as per the rules of IIT (ISM) Dhanbad.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs. 58,000 fellowship?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice states the fellowship as Rs. 58,000.00 PM + HRA as per the rules of IIT (ISM) Dhanbad.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Research Associate-I post?
faq.answer: Email a single PDF containing your CV, related publications and proof of work experience (if any) to the PI at [email protected] by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What should I write in the email subject line?
faq.answer: Write "Application for the position of PDF under Gates Foundation project" in the subject of the email.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for the Research Associate-I post?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted on merit and project requirements, and shortlisted candidates will be informed of the interview date. No TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Research Associate-I position permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a project position. The initial tenure is one year, which may be extended based on annual performance evaluation and project requirement, within the project tenure of two years or until project completion, whichever is earlier.
